summary: OddOne conducts a massive 1,160 summon session aiming to unlock Inspiration 3 (three copies) for the premium Aura legendary Anneliesis. He explains the banner mechanics, noting a guaranteed copy at 300 summons and a hidden 1,000-summon pity for the featured premium hero. Anneliesis's Inspiration 3 grants a permanent 10% Max HP and 10% Damage Bonus to all allies at battle start, making it a powerful milestone. After hitting high pity on multiple legendaries, he successfully pulls two copies and claims the 300-milestone copy to reach I3.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.verdict: Top tier Aura buffer (worth targeting I3)
heroes.note: Her Inspiration 3 grants all allies 10% Max HP and 10% Damage Bonus at battle start, while her Inspiration 2 adds 10% damage when allies have shields.

heroes.name: Eurion
heroes.note: Praised as an amazing tank hero during summons, though duplicate copies have diminished returns after Inspiration 5.

tips: The 300-summon accumulated guarantee banner features a hidden pity at 1,000 summons that guarantees the featured premium legendary.
Anneliesis's Inspiration 2 passive synergizes naturally with continuous shield providers like Solmo to maintain a 10% team damage buff.
title: 💥 Over 1000 Summons For i3 Anneliesis 💥 My BIGGEST Summon Session EVER | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
